SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE u.id=#{userId} AND u.status='active' AND p.permission_key=#{permission} AND ((ur.scope_type='asset' AND ur.scope_id=CAST(#{assetId} AS CHAR)) OR (r.role_key='platform_admin' AND ur.scope_type='global' AND ur.scope_id='*')) )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_task (task_key, event_id, policy_id, action_request_json, status, requested_by, idempotency_key, request_digest, expires_at) VALUES (#{taskKey}, #{eventId}, #{policyId}, #{snapshot}, 'pending', #{requestedBy}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestDigest}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_task at SET status=#{status}, reviewed_by=#{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), decision_reason=#{reason} WHERE at.id=#{id} AND at.status='pending' AND at.requested_by<>#{actorId} AND at.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE u.id=#{actorId} AND u.status='active' AND p.permission_key='approval.decide' AND ((ur.scope_type='asset' AND ur.scope_id=CAST(#{assetId} AS CHAR)) OR (r.role_key='platform_admin' AND ur.scope_type='global' AND ur.scope_id='*')) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset_authorization aa WHERE aa.asset_id=#{assetId} AND aa.status='active' AND aa.valid_from<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND aa.valid_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND JSON_CONTAINS(aa.scope_json, JSON_QUOTE(#{actionType}), '$.actionTypes') ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM response_policy rp WHERE rp.id=#{policyId} AND rp.status='active' AND rp.approved_by IS NOT NULL AND rp.auto_execute=FALSE AND rp.approval_required=TRUE AND rp.action_type=#{actionType} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM event_asset_link eal JOIN security_event se ON se.id=eal.event_id WHERE eal.event_id=#{eventId} AND eal.asset_id=#{assetId} AND se.status IN ('open','investigating','contained') ) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM asset a WHERE a.id=#{assetId} AND a.status='active')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (occurred_at, actor_type, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, outcome, reason) VALUES (#{occurredAt}, 'human', #{actorId}, #{action}, 'approval_task', #{approvalId}, #{requestId}, 'success', #{reason})
INSERT INTO audit_resource_scope (audit_id, scope_type, scope_id) VALUES (#{auditId}, 'asset', CAST(#{assetId} AS CHAR))

INSERT INTO event_timeline (event_id, occurred_at, entry_type, actor_type, actor_id, summary, details_json) VALUES (#{eventId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), #{entryType}, 'human', CAST(#{actorId} AS CHAR), #{summary}, JSON_OBJECT('approvalTaskId', #{taskId}))
